# Data Source: stripe_financial_connections_transaction

A transaction of a bank account linked through Financial Connections, as the account's institution reported it. Look one up by its `id`. An account has transactions only after a transaction refresh, which needs its `transactions` permission, and this data source never starts one: subscribe the account to transactions through Stripe's API first (`POST /v1/financial_connections/accounts/{account}/subscribe` with `features[]=transactions`), which starts the first refresh, and read its transactions, which `GET /v1/financial_connections/transactions?account={account}` lists, once the account's `transaction_refresh.status` is `succeeded`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_financial_connections_transaction" "latest" {
  id = "fctxn_1MwVKA2eZvKYlo2CqJ2kN5Ze"
}

output "transaction_amount" {
  value = data.stripe_financial_connections_transaction.latest.amount
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the financial connections transaction to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `account` - The ID of the Financial Connections Account this transaction belongs to.
* `amount` - The amount of this transaction, in cents (or local equivalent).
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `description` - The description of this transaction.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - The status of the transaction. Possible values: `pending`, `posted`, `void`.
* `status_transitions` - See [`status_transitions`](#status_transitions) below.
* `transacted_at` - Time at which the transaction was transacted. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `transaction_refresh` - The token of the transaction refresh that last updated or created this transaction.
* `updated` - Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

<a id="status_transitions"></a>
### `status_transitions`

The `status_transitions` attribute supports:

* `posted_at` - Time at which this transaction posted. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `void_at` - Time at which this transaction was voided. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
